correctness.rationale: The proof is self-contained. Contracting any 3-set C gives a loopless rank-2 matroid. Two remaining points are parallel exactly when C together with them is a nonbasis. Johnson stability makes this pair graph a matching; on n-3>=9 vertices such a matching has an independent 5-set, whose restriction is U_{2,5}. No finite experiment is needed for the theorem.
residual_risks: The bound n>=12 is sharp for this matching-independence argument, not asserted to classify all n<=11 cases.
